rationale: Applied iterative largest-normalized-residual (LNR) bad-data detection. Initial WLS estimate with all 5 measurements yielded normalized residuals. The measurement 'inj_b3' had the largest normalized residual (≈3.89) exceeding threshold 3.0. After removing it and re-estimating with remaining 4 measurements, all normalized residuals fell below 3.0, indicating convergence. The corrected state represents the final WLS estimate after bad-data removal.
